"1,441"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "1,194"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "1,457"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                      Let the Cost Price (CP) be 100 units.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Marked Price (MP) = 100 + 44% of 100 = 144 units.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Selling Price (SP) = 144 × (100 − 25) ÷ 100 = 144 × 0.75 = 108 units.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Profit = 108 − 100 = 8 units. Given 8 units = ₹67.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      List Price (MP) = (67 ÷ 8) × 144 = 67 × 18 = ₹1,206.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is ₹1,206.

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                      \nGiven: Markup % = 44%, Discount % = 25%, Profit = ₹67.\nFormulas: Profit = SP − CP | SP = MP × (100 − D%) ÷ 100 | MP = CP × (100 + Markup%) ÷ 100.\n
                                                                                                                                                      \n⇒ Assume CP = x.\n⇒ Marked Price (MP) = x + 0.44x = 1.44x.\n⇒ Selling Price (SP) = 1.44x × (1 − 0.25) = 1.44x × 0.75 = 1.08x.\n⇒ Profit = SP − CP = 1.08x − x = 0.08x.\n⇒ 0.08x = 67 ⇒ x = 67 ÷ 0.08 = 837.5.\n⇒ List Price (MP) = 1.44 × 837.5 = ₹1,206.\n

                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is ₹1,206.

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Effective Profit/Loss Percentage

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      The net result of a markup and a discount can be calculated using the formula: Net % = M − D − (M × D) ÷ 100, where M is markup % and D is discount %.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Relationship between MP and CP

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      MP ÷ CP = (100 + Profit%) ÷ (100 − Discount%). This is useful for finding ratios directly.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      विक्रय मूल्य (SP) = 144 × (100 − 25) ÷ 100 = 144 × 0.75 = 108 यूनिट।

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      लाभ = 108 − 100 = 8 यूनिट। दिया गया है 8 यूनिट = ₹67.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      सूची मूल्य (MP) = (67 ÷ 8) × 144 = 67 × 18 = ₹1,206.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ∴ सही उत्तर ₹1,206 है।

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                      \n⇒ माना CP = x.\n⇒ अंकित मूल्य (MP) = x + 0.44x = 1.44x.\n⇒ विक्रय मूल्य (SP) = 1.44x × (1 − 0.25) = 1.44x × 0.75 = 1.08x.\n⇒ लाभ = SP − CP = 1.08x − x = 0.08x.\n⇒ 0.08x = 67 ⇒ x = 67 ÷ 0.08 = 837.5.\n⇒ सूची मूल्य (MP) = 1.44 × 837.5 = ₹1,206.\n

                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      प्रभावी लाभ/हानि प्रतिशत

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      अंकित मूल्य और छूट के शुद्ध परिणाम की गणना इस सूत्र का उपयोग करके की जा सकती है: शुद्ध % = M − D − (M × D) ÷ 100, जहाँ M अंकित मूल्य % है और D छूट % है।

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      MP और CP के बीच संबंध

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      MP ÷ CP = (100 + लाभ%) ÷ (100 − छूट%)। यह सीधे अनुपात ज्ञात करने के लिए उपयोगी है।

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Net change = [ 0.72 × 0.72 × 2.41 ] − 1 = 1.249488 − 1 = 0.249488

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Percentage increase ≈ 25%.

"15%"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "17%"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "25%"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                      Volume of a cylinder V ∝ r2h.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Net change in Volume = [ (1 − 0.28)2 × (1 + 1.41) ] − 1

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Net change = [ 0.72 × 0.72 × 2.41 ] − 1 = 1.249488 − 1 = 0.249488

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Percentage increase ≈ 25%.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 25%.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Given:

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Decrease in Radius (r) = 28% ⇒ Final r = 100 − 28 = 72% of Initial

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Increase in Height (h) = 141% ⇒ Final h = 100 + 141 = 241% of Initial

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Volume of Right Circular Cylinder = πr2h

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Let Initial Radius = 100 and Initial Height = 100

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Initial Volume (V1) = π × (100)2 × 100 = 1,000,000π

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ New Radius = 72 and New Height = 241

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ New Volume (V2) = π × (72)2 × 241

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ V2 = π × 5184 × 241 = 1,249,344π

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Percentage Increase = [ (V2 − V1) ÷ V1 ] × 100

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Percentage Increase = [ (1,249,344π − 1,000,000π) ÷ 1,000,000π ] × 100

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Percentage Increase = [ 249,344 ÷ 1,000,000 ] × 100 = 24.9344%

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Closest integer value = 25%

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 25%.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Successive Percentage Change

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      For r2, use formula x + y + (xy/100) twice or use the multiplier method for easier calculation when percentages are large.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Surface Area Change

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh. Change in CSA depends on only one power of r and one power of h.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Cylinder Properties

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(h + r). Changes in TSA involve additive terms and do not follow simple product rules. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                      बेलन का आयतन V ∝ r2h होता है।

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      आयतन में शुद्ध परिवर्तन = [ (1 − 0.28)2 × (1 + 1.41) ] − 1

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      शुद्ध परिवर्तन = [ 0.72 × 0.72 × 2.41 ] − 1 = 1.249488 − 1 = 0.249488

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      प्रतिशत वृद्धि ≈ 25%।

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ∴ सही उत्तर 25% है।

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      त्रिज्या (r) में कमी = 28% ⇒ अंतिम r = 100 − 28 = प्रारंभिक का 72%

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ऊंचाई (h) में वृद्धि = 141% ⇒ अंतिम h = 100 + 141 = प्रारंभिक का 241%

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      लंब वृत्तीय बेलन का आयतन = πr2h

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      गणना:

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ माना प्रारंभिक त्रिज्या = 100 और प्रारंभिक ऊंचाई = 100

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ प्रारंभिक आयतन (V1) = π × (100)2 × 100 = 1,000,000π

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ नई त्रिज्या = 72 और नई ऊंचाई = 241

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ नया आयतन (V2) = π × (72)2 × 241

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ V2 = π × 5184 × 241 = 1,249,344π

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ प्रतिशत वृद्धि = [ (V2 − V1) ÷ V1 ] × 100

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ प्रतिशत वृद्धि = [ (1,249,344π − 1,000,000π) ÷ 1,000,000π ] × 100

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ प्रतिशत वृद्धि = [ 249,344 ÷ 1,000,000 ] × 100 = 24.9344%

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ निकटतम पूर्णांक मान = 25%

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ∴ सही उत्तर 25% है।

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      क्रमिक प्रतिशत परिवर्तन

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      r2 के लिए, सूत्र x + y + (xy/100) का दो बार उपयोग करें या प्रतिशत अधिक होने पर आसान गणना के लिए गुणक विधि (multiplier method) का उपयोग करें।

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल में परिवर्तन

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (CSA) = 2πrh. CSA में परिवर्तन r की एक घात और h की एक घात पर निर्भर करता है।

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      बेलन के गुण

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (TSA) = 2πr(h + r). TSA में परिवर्तनों में योगात्मक पद शामिल होते हैं और ये सरल गुणन नियमों का पालन नहीं करते हैं।

                                                                                                                                                      \n17a:T73b,

                                                                                                                                                      ఇచ్చినవి:

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      స్థూపం యొక్క వ్యాసార్థం 28% తగ్గింది

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      స్థూపం యొక్క ఎత్తు 141% పెరిగింది

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      స్థూపం యొక్క ఘనపరిమాణం = π x r2 x h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      శాతం మార్పు = ((కొత్త విలువ − అసలు విలువ) ÷ అసలు విలువ) x 100

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      గణన:

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ అసలు వ్యాసార్థం = r అనుకుందాం

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ అసలు ఎత్తు = h అనుకుందాం

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ కొత్త వ్యాసార్థం = r x (1 − 28 ÷ 100)

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ కొత్త వ్యాసార్థం = 0.72r

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ కొత్త ఎత్తు = h x (1 + 141 ÷ 100)

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ కొత్త ఎత్తు = 2.41h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ అసలు ఘనపరిమాణం = π x r2 x h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ కొత్త ఘనపరిమాణం = π x (0.72r)2 x 2.41h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ కొత్త ఘనపరిమాణం = π x 0.5184r2 x 2.41h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ కొత్త ఘనపరిమాణం = π x 1.249r2 x h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ పెరుగుదల కారకం = 1.249 − 1

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ పెరుగుదల కారకం = 0.249

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ శాతం పెరుగుదల = 0.249 x 100

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ శాతం పెరుగుదల = 24.9%

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ దగ్గరి పూర్ణాంకం = 25%

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ∴ సరైన సమాధానం 25.

                                                                                                                                                      \n17c:Ta06,\n

                                                                                                                                                      প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      একটি চোঙের ব্যাসার্ধ 28% হ্রাস করা হয়েছে।

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      চোঙের উচ্চতা 141% বৃদ্ধি করা হয়েছে।

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      অনুসৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      চোঙের আয়তন = π × r2 × h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      শতকরা পরিবর্তন = ((নতুন মান − আসল মান) ÷ আসল মান) × 100

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n<", "bn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                      প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      একটি চোঙের ব্যাসার্ধ 28% হ্রাস করা হয়েছে।

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      চোঙের উচ্চতা 141% বৃদ্ধি করা হয়েছে।

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      অনুসৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      চোঙের আয়তন = π × r2 × h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      শতকরা পরিবর্তন = ((নতুন মান − আসল মান) ÷ আসল মান) × 100

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ধরি, আসল ব্যাসার্ধ = r

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ধরি, আসল উচ্চতা = h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ নতুন ব্যাসার্ধ = r × (1 − 28 ÷ 100)

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ নতুন ব্যাসার্ধ = 0.72r

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ নতুন উচ্চতা = h × (1 + 141 ÷ 100)

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ নতুন উচ্চতা = 2.41h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ আসল আয়তন = π × r2 × h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ নতুন আয়তন = π × (0.72r)2 × 2.41h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ নতুন আয়তন = π × 0.5184r2 × 2.41h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ নতুন আয়তন = π × 1.249r2 × h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ বৃদ্ধির গুণক = 1.249 − 1

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ বৃদ্ধির গুণক = 0.249

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ শতকরা বৃদ্ধি = 0.249 × 100

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ শতকরা বৃদ্ধি = 24.9%

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ নিকটতম পূর্ণসংখ্যা = 25%

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ∴ সঠিক উত্তর হল 25

                                                                                                                                                      આપેલ:

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      નળાકારની ત્રિજ્યા 28% ઘટાડવામાં આવે છે.

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      નળાકારની ઊંચાઈ 141% વધારવામાં આવે છે.

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલ સૂત્ર:

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      નળાકારનું કદ = π x r2 x h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ટકાવારી ફેરફાર = ((નવું મૂલ્ય − મૂળ મૂલ્ય) ÷ મૂળ મૂલ્ય) x 100

                                                                                                                                                      ગણતરી:

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ધારો કે મૂળ ત્રિજ્યા = r

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ધારો કે મૂળ ઊંચાઈ = h

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ નવી ત્રિજ્યા = r x (1 − 28 ÷ 100)

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ નવી ત્રિજ્યા = 0.72r

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ નવી ઊંચાઈ = h x (1 + 141 ÷ 100)

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ નવી ઊંચાઈ = 2.41h

"correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                      Value 1 = 65% of 75 = 0.65 × 75 = 48.75

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Value 2 = 3/5 of 55 = 3 × 11 = 33

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Difference = 48.75 − 33 = 15.75

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 15.75.

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Given:

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      First expression = 65% of 75

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Second expression = 3/5 of 55

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ First value = (65/100) × 75

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ First value = 0.65 × 75 = 48.75

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Second value = (3/5) × 55

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Second value = 3 × 11 = 33

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Difference = 48.75 − 33

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Difference = 15.75

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 15.75.

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Percentage to Fraction Conversion

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      To convert x% to a fraction, divide x by 100. Example: 65% = 65/100 = 13/20.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Fraction of a Number

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      The word 'of' in mathematics represents multiplication. (a/b) of N = (a/b) × N.

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Decimal Multiplication Trick

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      Multiply the numbers as whole numbers first, then place the decimal point based on the total decimal places in the factors. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                      मान 1 = 75 का 65% = 0.65 × 75 = 48.75

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      मान 2 = 55 का 3/5 = 3 × 11 = 33

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      अंतर = 48.75 − 33 = 15.75

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ∴ सही उत्तर 15.75 है।

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      पहला व्यंजक = 75 का 65%

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      दूसरा व्यंजक = 55 का 3/5

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      गणना:

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ पहला मान = (65/100) × 75

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ पहला मान = 0.65 × 75 = 48.75

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ दूसरा मान = (3/5) × 55

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                      x% को भिन्न में बदलने के लिए, x को 100 से विभाजित करें। उदाहरण: 65% = 65/100 = 13/20.
